    need(signal.getitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL)==(0.0,0.0),'TIMER_ALREADY_ACTIVE')
    def expired(*_):raise m.Stop('PUBLIC_SUPPLY_DEADLINE')
    signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,expired);signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL,deadline.seconds());timer=True
    # Snapshot actual protected ancestry before any write, retain the identities,
    # then use the unchanged no-follow FD traversal and equality checks throughout.
    for p in m.chain(PARENT):
        fd=fs.open_dir(p)
        try:r['parents'][p]=fs.meta(fd)
        finally:os.close(fd)
    need(r['parents'][PARENT]['uid']==UID and r['parents'][PARENT]['gid']==UID and r['parents'][PARENT]['mode']==0o700 and r['parents'][PARENT]['context']==PARENT_CONTEXT,'PUBLIC_PARENT_PROTECTION')
    fs.parent_checks();fs.absent(GATE)
    for p in ABSENT:fs.absent(p)
    for p in DIRS:fs.mkdir(p,CONTEXT)
    for p,b in raw.items():fs.write_new(p,b,CONTEXT)
    files={}
    for p in raw:
        data,meta=fs.read_file(p,CONTEXT);need(data==raw[p],'PUBLIC_READBACK');files[p]=meta
    for p,names in INVENTORIES.items():need(fs.names(p)==set(names),'EXACT_CODE_INVENTORY')
    fs.identity();fs.parent_checks();fs.tick()
    result={'status':'PUBLIC_SUPPLIED_VERIFIED_NOT_EXECUTED','host':HOST,'boot_id':BOOT,'kind':KIND,'new_id':NEW_ID,'files':files,'directories':{p:fs.directory(p,0o700,CONTEXT) for p in DIRS},'created':fs.created,'parent_metadata':r['parents'],'candidate_sha256':CANDIDATE,'credential_actions':0,'runtime_entry_calls':0,'observed_at':dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True));rc=0
except BaseException as exc:
    print(json.dumps({'status':'STOP_PRESERVE_PARTIAL','host':HOST,'kind':KIND,'error_code':str(exc) if isinstance(exc,(m.Stop,Stop)) else type(exc).__name__,'created':[] if fs is None else fs.created,'retry':False,'cleanup_performed':False},sort_keys=True));rc=2
finally:
    if timer:signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL,0)
raise SystemExit(rc)
